comment: Menu item names for the installed 2.1.0. Chronoblob2 is the only module in the plugin with a menu of its own, and it has two items: the first prints with the infinity glyph in front of it, matching the loop button's panel icon, and the line drops that glyph because the lines are spoken. The Sync prescaler choices are printed with multiplication and division signs; the line spells them out. No number was added to any line in this pass. check_numbers.py flags the 1.5 in the Sync prescaler line: it is not a figure of its own but the text of two menu items, times 1.5 and divided by 1.5. The 2.73 seconds it also flags was already recorded in NUMBER-CHECK.md as computed from a buffer length rather than stored.
